svg.aria-label: Three ways for a server to push chat messages, as sequence diagrams. Polling: the client asks on a timer and usually hears nothing. Long polling: the server holds each request open until a message arrives or a timeout fires, then the client asks again immediately. WebSocket: one HTTP request is upgraded (101 Switching Protocols) into a persistent connection that carries messages in both directions.
svg.title: Polling, long polling and WebSocket
